details:
Time passes, and it's getting more and more tiresome to witness groups using their tools abruptely to kick or ban.

You just want to have fun, you play the game, everything goes well, until some toxic people come along. You can't even say, or even do anything like mute or block, something that VRChat itself promoted some weeks ago, with the term "auto-moderation" ; as soon as you raise concerns, become upset in front of toxicity, more and more someone in the whatever-is-called group holding the instance will come, and will kick or ban you instantly.

I begin to be overtired to see toxic people that can't handle themselves, or this group mindset that only think about themselves. It reminds me of someone that spoke during the trial about ESRB creation : letting moderation tools in the hands of toxic people, will be the equivalent as "letting to troublemakers the charge of the classroom".

Also, many times I saw in their rules "do not mute or block staff members, or you'll be kicked/banned", but this goes against free will and auto-moderation spirit. What if the person is mute/deafen, speak another langage, wants to be at peace, is scared ? No help, comprehension, common sense is used at all.

I said it in a feedback I made already some months ago, but I raise the concern again : the concept of "group" should not happen this way. Not when seeing so many problems with it.
title: Group system seriously needs to be redesigned
